subject: POC orbit: activation checklist & close cadence
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@edgehealth.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@edgehealth.io
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: MAP & timeline for POC activation

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move to a short POC to validate latency and cost for real workloads. Can you share a mutual action plan and an activation timeline so we can align internal ops and procurement? Our checklist will need to cover org setup, API keys, IP allowlist, and VPC peering.

High-level ask: can we get a concrete next-steps list + dates so I can push this into our procurement cadence? We are targeting an internal pilot window starting ~Dec 20.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Chen
Head of Integrations, EdgeHealth

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice@edgehealth.io>
Cc: procurement@edgehealth.io, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 13:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: MAP & timeline for POC activation

Alice — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a concise MAP (EdgeHealth_MAP_v1.pdf) and a compact activation checklist. Below is the working plan; happy to adjust owners/dates based on your procurement window.

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Week 0 (Dec 2-6): Org & accounts
  - Redwood creates EdgeHealth trial org in our console (action: Marissa Cole)
  - EdgeHealth confirms primary admin and SSO contact (action: Alice)
- Week 1 (Dec 7-13): Credentials & allowlist
  - API key creation and role assignment (action: Marissa)
  - IP allowlist: EdgeHealth provides CIDR(s); Redwood will add to allowlist for trial endpoints (action: Neha)
- Week 2 (Dec 14-17): Network peering & smoke tests
  - VPC peering request from EdgeHealth cloud account (instructions in attachment)
  - Redwood validates routes, opens test endpoints; run smoke test harness (action: Neha + DevOps)
- Week 3 (Dec 18-20): Pilot start
  - Run sample traffic (latency/throughput metrics), collect cost-per-token baseline (owners: EdgeHealth + Redwood)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:22:45 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MAP details — peering and allowlist notes

Jonas / Marissa — quick notes from infra/security side after skimming the MAP: 

- VPC peering: prefer to run peering as a request from EdgeHealth account into our peering console to avoid cross-account key exchange. We'll provide a JSON template they can paste into their cloud console. I can own the validation and BGP/routing checks.
- IP allowlist: ask EdgeHealth to provide both production/testing CIDRs. For the POC, we can add a temporary /32 float if they need it quickly, but we should capture the final CIDR list before Dec 13 to avoid rework.
- API keys: Marissa, we should gate API key creation on the org admin confirmation + a signed NDA (procurement should confirm). Once NDA is in place, I'll approve the network rules change.

I'll draft the peering template and a short validation checklist by EOD today.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:10:03 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP details — org/admin/API key flow

I can take the org/admin flow. Proposed quick runbook (attached as env-activation-runbook.md):
1) Create EdgeHealth trial org and invite primary admin (Alice).
2) On acceptance, generate two API keys: one 'test' (limited SKUs, lower rate) and one 'pilot' (full trial quota). Keys are stored in the org console and rotated after 30 days.
3) Send temporary test-key to Alice via secure link; mark key with expiration (Dec 31) unless extended.

If procurement confirms NDA by end of day Friday (Dec 4), I'll create the org and issue keys during Week 1.

Marissa Cole
Senior Implementation Manager — Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice@edgehealth.io>
Cc: procurement@edgehealth.io, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: MAP & timeline for POC activation — next steps

Alice — pulling the thread together and confirming next steps & dates to lock the Dec 20 pilot. Short checklist for your team with owners and ask items: 

1) Confirm primary org admin (reply to this thread) — owner: EdgeHealth (Alice) — target: Dec 4
2) Procurement: sign NDA + confirm minimal order (for trial billing) — owner: EdgeHealth procurement — target: Dec 4
3) Provide IP CIDRs for test + production (JSON list or single /32 for quick start) — owner: EdgeHealth infra — target: Dec 10
4) VPC peering request: paste our peering template (attached) into cloud console and send peering acceptance — owner: EdgeHealth infra — target: Dec 14
5) Redwood: create trial org & generate test/pilot API keys after NDA + admin confirmed — owner: Marissa Cole — target: Dec 7
6) Redwood: validate peering and open test endpoints; run smoke tests — owner: Neha Kapoor — target: Dec 15
7) Pilot start: run baseline traffic and collect latency/cost metrics — owner: EdgeHealth + Redwood — target: Dec 20

Links: MAP document (internal): https://redwood.app/s/eh-map-042
DocuSign (NDA): https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/EH-042-activation

Attachments: EdgeHealth_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with checklist), env-activation-runbook.md (internal runbook).

If we get the NDA and admin confirmation by Friday (Dec 4), we are on track for your target pilot window. If you want, I can set up a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow afternoon to walk through the peering template and allowlist format.

Thanks — looking forward to this one.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
